client.name: Falaj Community Bank
client.fictional_note: Falaj Community Bank is a fictional bank. Its profile is a composite of a small digital bank in Abu Dhabi; it is not any real institution.

brand.tagline: Banking that flows to the community

facts: App, contact centre and one branch; Arabic and English

rates._note: Illustrative reference market rates in $ per million tokens. Not quotes.

private.label: private open-weight model running in the bank's own infrastructure

agents.name: Support chat
agents.desc: Explains charges, blocks cards, takes closure requests. Arabic and English.
agents.control: Card block needs customer confirmation; closures go to an officer.

agents.name: Onboarding assistant
agents.desc: Guides UAE Pass, Emirates ID and selfie checks; explains pending verification.
agents.control: Explains status and requests documents; never approves or rejects.

agents.name: KYC exception triage
agents.desc: Summarises stalled cases and missing documents for an analyst.
agents.control: Recommends a next step; an analyst decides every case.

agents.name: SME assistant
agents.desc: Payroll (WPS) files, payments and statements for small firms.

agents.name: Complaints and disputes
agents.desc: Classifies complaints, drafts replies and tracks deadlines.

agents.name: SME credit pre-assessment
agents.desc: Collects documents and drafts a credit memo for the credit team.

agents.name: Circular review
agents.desc: Summarises new public regulator circulars for compliance.

addons_extra: Arabic voice agent for the contact centre.

title: FireFlow at
Falaj Community Bank.
intro.lead: How the FireFlow commercial journey could run for a small digital bank in Abu Dhabi. The bank is fictional; every figure is an illustrative assumption.

title: A digital bank
for its community.
bank.lead: Falaj serves individuals and small businesses through its app, a contact centre and one branch. Partners handle cash and cheque deposits.

items.title: Faster answers
items.text: Customers struggle to reach support at peak times.

items.title: Faster onboarding
items.text: Some identity verifications stall for days.

items.title: SME growth
items.text: Payroll, payments and credit for small firms.

gate: Agents act inside approved limits, and customer data stays on private models.

title: Three agents first.
More when ready.
use_cases.lead: Stage 1 scopes three agents. The others follow later as optional add-on services.

title: Runs inside the bank.
Controlled by the bank.
systems.lead: FireFlow is installed in the bank's own data centre or private cloud. Bank engineers connect its systems and decide what each agent may do.

items.title: On-premises deployment
items.text: FireFlow and its data stay inside the bank's infrastructure.

items.title: Bank-controlled access
items.text: Bank engineers connect core banking, eKYC and CRM through approved APIs.

items.title: No vendor access to data
items.text: Persistent Labs works only with mock data and never sees bank or customer data.

gate: Customer data and the AI models stay inside the bank's infrastructure. Persistent Labs has no access.

title: Staging for
three agents.
staging.lead: Persistent Labs sets up an isolated staging environment with mock data, trains the bank's business and engineering teams and writes the three agent specifications.
note: Mock customer data; no production access.
gate: Staging ready; specifications for all three agents signed off.

title: Build and test
in two languages.
build.lead: Agents are built against sandbox APIs, with Arabic and English test sets agreed with the bank.
gate: All three agents pass the agreed tests; the bank's business and engineering teams can edit the flows.

title: Controls before
customers.
prepare.lead: Persistent Labs and the bank agree what each agent may do alone and what needs a person.
gate: Bank infosec and compliance approve the plan; Persistent Labs and the bank test the controls and the emergency stop.

title: Start with
5% of customers.
rollout.lead: The bank's engineers connect production APIs. About 5% of app users get the new chat and onboarding help; KYC triage runs on live cases.
gate: Expand once compliance has reviewed the audit trail and four weeks have passed without critical incidents.

title: All customers.
Bank in control.
operate.lead: Customer agents reach all app users; KYC triage handles every stalled case. The bank runs operations; Persistent Labs maintains the platform.
split: Updates, fixes and incident support, with no access to customer data.

title: Inference costs
at full volume.
usage.lead: Monthly estimate at full volume. All three agents run on a private model inside the bank, so the 25% rate applies to a market-rate reference.
gate: Monthly in arrears. The reference is only the basis for the surcharge; the bank's own hardware is not billed again.

title: What could
come next.
addons.lead: Each add-on gets its own statement of work, price and acceptance tests.

title: Year one,
in one view.
year_one.lead: Months 1–12 for the three initial agents. Add-on services are excluded.
